name: generator inside sum any all
code: print(sum(x * x for x in range(5)), any(x > 3 for x in range(5)), all(x >= 0 for x in range(5)))

name: generator short circuit
code:
def side(x):
    print('s', x)
    return x
print(any(side(x) > 1 for x in [0, 1, 2, 3]))
print(all(side(x) < 2 for x in [0, 1, 2, 3]))

name: comprehension variable does not leak
code:

name: comprehension using outer variable
